Resolved native request. All byte spans and radio are borrowed during create. Native creation never changes mixer settings or reads tuning EEPROM. Each stopped-to-started transition applies only explicitly selected hardware gains before GPIO or audio starts; omitted controls and all switches are preserved. Radio generation/frame bounds/publication cadence are set by native lifecycle; effective released ABI-4 radio settings are otherwise preserved. Inactive signaling fields are normalized by the typed radio configuration.

detaileddescription.para: Only the selected input record is used. Snapshot storage is initialized by the host. A zero result and accepted ABI confirm success; otherwise the result is a product error or -1 for malformed/unsupported transport. No new device is opened. A successful write means queued, not physical readback.
